mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 305), the Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A level of the industrial production index above 100 (indicating expansion relative to the 2017 base year) signals robust industrial activity and economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) falls below 157,000 (thousands), it signals a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 157000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a positive growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-recession recovery when GDPC1 is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) and the unemployment rate is high (UNRATE > 5.0%), it indicates a monetary policy response to a weak labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 5.0% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
